title: cli-meiju-grants

meiju_power_grants.description: Trusted startup-only permission for one local device and exact power state over cloud. No wildcard, arbitrary action, provider identifier or confirmation flag. Empty grants no power permission.

meiju_fan_grants.description: Trusted startup-only permission for one local AC and one reviewed vendor wind_speed code over cloud. Independent of power grants; never a percentage, wildcard or ordinary request field.

meiju_mode_grants.description: Trusted startup-only permission to turn on one exact local AC and activate one reviewed vendor mode over cloud. This includes power-on; it grants no independent power, fan or temperature action.

meiju_temperature_grants.description: Trusted startup-only permission for one exact local AC and Celsius target over cloud. This union of reviewed setpoints does not define device capability bounds; the protected product mapping and action schema must also admit the target. No power, mode, fan or other target authority.

description: Explicit trusted Linux CLI startup grants. The owner-controlled file contains only exact local device IDs and allowed values, including explicit power-on/mode activation and exact temperature targets; no credentials, wildcard permissions or ordinary request approval flags. Missing or empty lists grant nothing.
